group: Early EOF – method should return immediately when context.eof is true

input.value: Context with eof=true, pos=0, modulus=0, ibitWorkArea=0

cases.expected: No change to context (pos remains 0, buffer unchanged) – method returns without processing
cases.description: Verifies the first guard clause `if (context.eof) return;`

group: Negative inAvail – should mark EOF and not produce output

cases.expected: context.eof == true after call, no bytes written to buffer
cases.description: Ensures the branch `if (inAvail < 0) { context.eof = true; }` works

group: Padding character detection – should set EOF and stop processing

cases.expected: context.eof == true, only first character processed, pos may be 0 because a full block was not completed
cases.description: Tests the `if (b == pad) { context.eof = true; break; }` path

group: Full block decoding – four valid Base64 chars produce three output bytes

cases.description: Runs through the main loop, hits `context.modulus == 0` after four chars and writes three decoded bytes

group: Trailing bits – modulus == 1 (invalid, should invoke validateTrailingCharacter)

input.value: Context with eof=true (simulated by inAvail<0), modulus=1, ibitWorkArea=0

cases.description: Ensures the switch case `case 1` is taken and the validator raises an exception

input.value: Context with eof=true, modulus=2, ibitWorkArea set to result of two Base64 chars (e.g., 0b001100 0b001001)

cases.expected: context.pos == 1 and context.buffer[0] equals the decoded single byte (0x0F for the chosen chars)
cases.description: Tests `case 2` – validateCharacter is called, extra 4 bits are discarded and one byte is written

input.value: Context with eof=true, modulus=3, ibitWorkArea set to result of three Base64 chars

cases.expected: context.pos == 2 and context.buffer[0..1] contain the two decoded bytes
cases.description: Covers `case 3` – validates the low 2 bits, discards them, and writes two bytes
Forces the default branch of the switch by setting an impossible modulus value

cases.expected: Only the valid Base64 characters ('A','B','C','D') affect decoding; the 0xFF byte is skipped. After processing a full block, three decoded bytes are produced.
cases.description: Ensures that bytes outside the range of `decodeTable` or with a negative table entry are ignored

group: Null input array – should throw NullPointerException

cases.description: Calling decode with a null byte[] should immediately raise NPE when the method attempts to read input[inPos]
The method accesses fields of the Context object; passing null must result in NPE

group: inPos out of bounds – should throw ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException

cases.description: When inPos points beyond the end of the input array the first read `input[inPos++]` triggers an AIOOBE

group: validateCharacter throws for non‑zero low 4 bits (modulus == 2)

input.value: Context with eof=true, modulus=2, ibitWorkArea=0b00001111 (low 4 bits = 0b1111)

cases.description: After the main loop, eof is true and modulus == 2, so `validateCharacter(MASK_4BITS, context)` is invoked. The low‑4‑bit mask is not zero, causing the validator to throw IllegalArgumentException

group: validateCharacter throws for non‑zero low 2 bits (modulus == 3)

input.value: Context with eof=true, modulus=3, ibitWorkArea=0b00000101 (low 2 bits = 0b01)

cases.description: When modulus == 3 the method calls `validateCharacter(MASK_2BITS, context)`. Because the lowest two bits are not zero, the validator throws IllegalArgumentException
